translations.literal: The next year, in the eighth month, when a rebel general was about to enter the territory, Zhibo urged him to depart.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the eighth month, as a rebel general was about to cross the border, Zhibo pressed him to leave.

sentences.zh: 士鬥曰：「安危生死與公共，復何往。」

translations.literal: Shidou said, "Security and peril, life and death—I share them with you, Excellency; where else would I go?
translations.idiomatic: Shidou said, "Peril and safety, life and death—I share them with you, Excellency. Where else would I go?

sentences.zh: 城陷被執，見之勃與張獻忠語，大呼曰：「此賊也，公不可少屈！」

translations.literal: When the city fell he was seized; seeing Zhibo speaking with Zhang Xianzhong, he cried out, "This man is a traitor! Your Excellency must not yield even slightly!
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was taken captive. Seeing Zhibo in conversation with Zhang Xianzhong, he shouted, "This man is a traitor! Your Excellency must not bend even a little!"

sentences.zh: 獻忠怒，命捽以上，士鬥又返顧之勃，語如前，遂闔門被殺。

translations.literal: Xianzhong flew into a rage and ordered him hauled forward; Shidou turned back again toward Zhibo and spoke as before, and then the whole household was put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzhong was enraged and ordered him dragged forward. Shidou looked back at Zhibo and spoke as before, and then his entire household was slaughtered.

sentences.zh: 同時沈雲祚，字子淩，太倉人。

translations.literal: At the same time there was Shen Yunzuo, styled Ziling, a native of Taicang.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time there was Shen Yunzuo, styled Ziling, from Taicang.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十三年進士。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chongzhen he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the Chongzhen reign he became a jinshi.

sentences.zh: 知華陽縣。

translations.literal: He served as magistrate of Huayang County.
translations.idiomatic: He served as magistrate of Huayang County.

sentences.zh: 有奸民為搖、黃賊耳目，設策捕戮之。

translations.literal: Certain wicked commoners served as eyes and ears for the Yao and Huang bandits; he devised a stratagem to capture and execute them.
translations.idiomatic: Certain wicked commoners acted as scouts for the Yao and Huang bandits, and he devised a plan to capture and execute them.

sentences.zh: 賊破夔門，成都大震，雲祚走謁蜀王，陳守禦策，不聽。

translations.literal: When the rebels broke through Kuimen, Chengdu was shaken; Yunzuo hurried to audience with the Prince of Shu and set forth plans of defense, but was not heeded.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels broke through Kuimen, Chengdu was thrown into turmoil. Yunzuo rushed to the Prince of Shu and laid out plans of defense, but was not heeded.

sentences.zh: 聞內江王至淥賢，往說之曰：「成都危在旦夕，而王府貨財山積，不及今募士殺賊，疆場淪喪，誰為王守？」

translations.literal: When he heard that the Prince of Neijiang had reached Zhilu, he went to persuade him, saying, "Chengdu faces ruin within the day, yet the princely house's wealth is piled like mountains; if you do not raise troops now to kill the rebels, once the frontier is lost, who will hold it for the prince?
translations.idiomatic: When he heard that the Prince of Neijiang had reached Zhilu, he went to persuade him, saying, "Chengdu will fall at any moment, yet the princely treasury is heaped like a mountain. If you do not raise troops now to kill the rebels, once the borderlands are lost, who will hold them for you?

sentences.zh: 至淥言於王，不聽。

translations.literal: When he reached Zhilu and spoke to the prince, the prince would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached Zhilu and spoke to the prince, the prince still would not listen.

sentences.zh: 賊迫成都，王始出財佐軍，已無及。

translations.literal: As the rebels pressed on Chengdu, the prince at last brought out funds to support the army, but it was already too late.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels closed on Chengdu, the prince at last brought out funds to support the army, but it was already too late.

sentences.zh: 城陷，獻忠欲用之，幽之大慈寺而遣其黨饋食，以刃脅降，不屈，遂遇害。

translations.literal: When the city fell, Xianzhong wished to employ him; he was confined in Daci Temple while the rebels' agents brought him food, and blades were put to his throat to force surrender, but he would not yield and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, Xianzhong wished to employ him. He was shut up in Daci Temple while the rebels' agents brought him food and blades were put to his throat to force surrender, but he would not yield and was killed.

sentences.zh: 王勵精，蒲城人。

translations.literal: Wang Lijing was a native of Pucheng.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lijing came from Pucheng.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，由選貢生授廣西府通判，仁恕善折獄。

translations.literal: In the Chongzhen period, through selection as a tribute student he was appointed vice prefect of Guangxi Prefecture; he was humane and forgiving and skilled at settling cases.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen period, through selection as a tribute student he was appointed vice prefect of Guangxi Prefecture. He was humane and forgiving, and skilled at settling cases.

sentences.zh: 歲兇，毀銀帶易粟，減價糶。

translations.literal: In a year of famine he destroyed his silver belt to exchange for grain and sold grain at reduced prices.
translations.idiomatic: In a year of famine he destroyed his silver official belt to buy grain and sold grain at reduced prices.

sentences.zh: 富人聞之，爭出粟，價遂平。

translations.literal: When the rich heard of this, they vied to bring out grain, and prices soon stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: When the wealthy heard of this, they competed to bring out grain, and prices soon stabilized.

sentences.zh: 遷崇慶知州，多善政。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be magistrate of Chongqing Prefecture, where he carried out many good policies.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to be magistrate of Chongqing Prefecture, where he carried out many good policies.

sentences.zh: 十七年，張獻忠陷成都，州人驚竄。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, when Zhang Xianzhong took Chengdu, the people of the prefecture fled in panic.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, when Zhang Xianzhong took Chengdu, the people of the prefecture fled in terror.

sentences.zh: 勵精朝服北面拜，又西向拜父母，從容操筆書文信國成仁取義四語於壁，登樓縛利刃柱間，而置火藥樓下，危坐以俟。

translations.literal: Lijing, in court robes, bowed to the north, then bowed west toward his parents; calmly taking up his brush, he wrote on the wall the four words of Wen, the state's faithful minister—"achieve humanity in death, take righteousness in life"; he went upstairs, bound a sharp blade between the pillars, placed gunpowder below, and sat upright waiting.
translations.idiomatic: Lijing, in court robes, bowed to the north, then turned west and bowed to his parents. Calmly taking up his brush, he wrote on the wall the four words of Wen, the state's faithful minister: "Achieve humanity in death; take righteousness in life." He went upstairs, bound a sharp blade between the pillars, placed gunpowder below, and sat upright waiting.

sentences.zh: 俄聞賊騎渡江，即命舉火，火發，觸刃貫胸而死。

translations.literal: Soon he heard rebel horsemen crossing the river; he ordered the fire lit, and when the flames rose he ran against the blade and it pierced his chest, and he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he heard rebel horsemen crossing the river. He ordered the fire lit; when the flames rose he threw himself against the blade, and it pierced his chest and killed him.

sentences.zh: 賊嘆其忠，斂葬之。

translations.literal: The rebels sighed at his loyalty and gave him a proper burial.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels sighed at his loyalty and gave him a proper burial.

sentences.zh: 其墨跡久逾新，滌之不滅。

translations.literal: His ink traces long remained fresher than new writing; washed, they would not fade.
translations.idiomatic: His ink long looked fresher than new writing; washed, it would not fade.

sentences.zh: 後二十余年，州人建祠奉祀，祀甫畢，壁即頹，遠近嘆異。

translations.literal: More than twenty years later the people of the prefecture built a shrine to honor him; as soon as the rites were completed, the wall collapsed, and people near and far marveled.
translations.idiomatic: More than twenty years later the people of the prefecture built a shrine to honor him. As soon as the rites were completed, the wall collapsed, and people near and far marveled.

sentences.zh: 先是，十三年賊犯仁壽，知縣鄱陽劉三策拒守，城陷不屈死，贈尚寶司丞。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the thirteenth year, when the rebels attacked Renshou, Magistrate Liu Sance of Poyang held out in defense; when the city fell he refused to submit and died, and was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Seals Office.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the thirteenth year, when the rebels attacked Renshou, Liu Sance of Poyang, the county magistrate, held out in defense. When the city fell he refused to submit and died, and was posthumously granted Vice Director of the Seals Office.

sentences.zh: 及是再陷，知縣顧繩貽遇害。

translations.literal: When it fell again on this occasion, Magistrate Gu Shengji was killed.
translations.idiomatic: When it fell again on this occasion, Magistrate Gu Shengji was killed.

sentences.zh: 賊陷郫縣，主簿山陰趙嘉煒守都江堰，賊誘降，不從，投江死。

translations.literal: When the rebels took Pixian, Registrar Zhao Jiawei of Shanyin defended the Dujiangyan works; the rebels tried to induce him to surrender, but he would not follow them and drowned himself in the river.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels took Pixian, Registrar Zhao Jiawei of Shanyin defended the Dujiangyan works. The rebels tried to induce him to surrender, but he refused and drowned himself in the river.

sentences.zh: 陷綿竹，典史卜大經與其仆俱縊死，鄉官戶部郎中刁化神亦死之。

translations.literal: When Mianzhu fell, Archive Clerk Bu Dajing and his servant both hanged themselves; Village Officer Diao Huashen, a Director in the Ministry of Revenue, also died.
translations.idiomatic: When Mianzhu fell, Archive Clerk Bu Dajing and his servant both hanged themselves, and Village Officer Diao Huashen, a Director in the Ministry of Revenue, also died.

sentences.zh: 他若榮縣知縣漢陽秦民湯、蒲田知縣江夏朱蘊羅、興文知縣漢川艾吾鼎、南部知縣鄭夢眉、中江教諭攝劍州事單之賓，皆殉難。

translations.literal: Others such as Qin Mintang of Hanyang, magistrate of Rong County; Zhu Yunluo of Jiangxia, magistrate of Pujiang; Ai Wuding of Hanchuan, magistrate of Xingwen; Zheng Mengmei, magistrate of Nanbu; and Shan Zhibin, instructor of Zhongjiang who was acting in the affairs of Jianzhou—all died for the cause.
translations.idiomatic: Others too met martyrdom: Qin Mintang of Hanyang, magistrate of Rong County; Zhu Yunluo of Jiangxia, magistrate of Pujiang; Ai Wuding of Hanchuan, magistrate of Xingwen; Zheng Mengmei, magistrate of Nanbu; and Shan Zhibin, instructor of Zhongjiang who was acting in the affairs of Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 夢眉夫婦並縊。

translations.literal: Mengmei and his wife hanged themselves together.
translations.idiomatic: Mengmei and his wife hanged themselves together.

sentences.zh: 蘊羅、吾鼎闔家被難。

translations.literal: Yunluo and Wuding suffered disaster together with their whole households.
translations.idiomatic: Yunluo and Wuding suffered disaster together with their entire households.

sentences.zh: 宗室朱奉钅尹，由進士歷御史，劾督師丁啟睿諸疏，為時所稱。

translations.literal: Among the imperial clan, Zhu Fengyin, who had risen through the jinshi degree to serve as censor, was praised by his age for memorials impeaching Grand Secretary Ding Qirui and others.
translations.idiomatic: Among the imperial clan, Zhu Fengyin, who had risen through the jinshi degree to serve as censor, was praised in his day for memorials impeaching Grand Secretary Ding Qirui and others.

sentences.zh: 時裏居，並及於難。

translations.literal: He was then living at home on leave and perished in the calamity as well.
translations.idiomatic: He was then living at home on leave and perished in the calamity as well.

sentences.zh: 尹伸，字子求，宜賓人。

translations.literal: Yin Shen, styled Ziqiu, was a native of Yibin.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Shen, styled Ziqiu, came from Yibin.

sentences.zh: 萬歷二十六年進士。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year of Wanli he passed the jinshi examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year of the Wanli reign he became a jinshi.

sentences.zh: 授承天推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed reviewing secretary at Chengtian.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed reviewing secretary at Chengtian.

sentences.zh: 屢遷南京兵部郎中、西安知府、陜西提學副使、蘇松兵備參政。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Nanjing Ministry of War, Prefect of Xi'an, Vice Education Commissioner of Shaanxi, and Military Commissioner of the Suzhou-Songjiang circuit.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Nanjing Ministry of War, Prefect of Xi'an, Vice Education Commissioner of Shaanxi, and Military Commissioner of the Suzhou-Songjiang circuit.

sentences.zh: 公廉強直，不事弇阿，三任皆投劾去。

translations.literal: Just, incorruptible, and upright, he would not toady; in three posts he submitted his resignation and left.
translations.idiomatic: He was just, incorruptible, and upright, and would not toady. In three posts he submitted his resignation and left office.

sentences.zh: 天啟時，起故官，分守貴州威清道。

translations.literal: In the Tianqi period he was restored to his former post and assigned to guard the Weiqing circuit in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianqi period he was restored to his former post and assigned to guard the Weiqing circuit in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 貴陽圍解，巡撫王三善將深入，伸頗贊之，監軍西征。

translations.literal: When the siege of Guiyang was lifted, Grand Coordinator Wang San Shan was about to drive deep into enemy territory; Shen strongly supported the plan and supervised the western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: When the siege of Guiyang was lifted, Grand Coordinator Wang Sanshan was about to drive deep into enemy territory. Shen strongly supported the plan and supervised the western campaign.

sentences.zh: 三善敗歿，伸突圍歸，坐奪官，戴罪辦賊。

translations.literal: When Sanshan was defeated and killed, Shen broke out of encirclement and returned; he was stripped of rank, made to serve with a suspended sentence, and ordered to deal with the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When Sanshan was defeated and killed, Shen broke out of encirclement and returned. He was stripped of rank, made to serve with a suspended sentence, and ordered to deal with the bandits.

sentences.zh: 四年，賊圍普安，伸赴援，賊解去，遂移駐其地。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, when bandits besieged Pu'an, Shen went to the relief; the bandits withdrew, and he then moved his headquarters to that place.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, when bandits besieged Pu'an, Shen went to the relief. The bandits withdrew, and he then moved his headquarters there.

sentences.zh: 賊復來攻，率參將範邦雄破走之，逐北至三岔河。

translations.literal: When the bandits attacked again, he led Vice General Fan Bangxiong to defeat and drive them off, pursuing them north to the San Cha River.
translations.idiomatic: When the bandits attacked again, he led Vice General Fan Bangxiong to defeat and drive them off, pursuing them north to the San Cha River.

sentences.zh: 總督蔡復一上其功，免戴罪，貶一秩視事。

translations.literal: Governor-General Cai Fuyi submitted a report of his merit; his suspended sentence was lifted, and he was demoted one rank and continued in office.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Cai Fuyi submitted a report of his merit. His suspended sentence was lifted, and he was demoted one rank and continued in office.

sentences.zh: 崇禎五年歷河南右布政使，以失禦流賊，罷歸。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongzhen he rose to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan; for failing to repel the roving bandits he was dismissed and sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of the Chongzhen reign he rose to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan. For failing to repel the roving bandits he was dismissed and sent home.

sentences.zh: 伸所至與長吏迕，然待人有始終，篤分義，工詩善書，日課楷書五百字，寒暑不輟。

translations.literal: Wherever he went he clashed with senior officials, yet he treated people with constancy to the end, was deeply loyal to friendship and duty, was skilled in poetry and calligraphy, and daily copied five hundred characters in regular script, summer and winter without pause.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever he went he clashed with senior officials, yet he treated people with constancy to the end, was deeply loyal to friendship and duty, was skilled in poetry and calligraphy, and daily copied five hundred characters in regular script without pause through summer and winter.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠陷敘州，匿山中，搜得之，罵不肯行。

translations.literal: When Zhang Xianzhong took Xuzhou, Shen hid in the mountains; when found in the search he cursed the rebels and refused to go.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Xianzhong took Xuzhou, Shen hid in the mountains. When found in the search he cursed the rebels and refused to go.

sentences.zh: 賊重其名，不殺。

translations.literal: The rebels respected his name and did not kill him.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels respected his name and did not kill him.

sentences.zh: 至並研，罵益厲，遂攢殺之。

translations.literal: At Jingyan he cursed all the more fiercely and was then beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Jingyan he cursed all the more fiercely and was then beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 福王時，起太常卿，伸已先死。

translations.literal: In the time of the Prince of Fu he was recalled as Grand Director of Imperial Sacrifices, but Shen had already died.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of the Prince of Fu he was recalled as Grand Director of Imperial Sacrifices, but Shen had already died.

sentences.zh: 蜀中士大夫在籍死難者，成都則雲南按察使莊祖誥，廣元則戶科給事中吳宇英，資縣則工部主事蔡如蕙，郫縣則舉人江騰龍。

translations.literal: Among the gentry of Shu who died at home in the calamity, in Chengdu there was Yunnan Surveillance Commissioner Zhuang Zuhao; in Guangyuan, Household Section Supervising Secretary Wu Yuying; in Zixian, Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Works Cai Ruhui; and in Pixian, Selected Scholar Jiang Tenglong.
translations.idiomatic: Among the gentry of Shu who died at home in the calamity, in Chengdu there was Yunnan Surveillance Commissioner Zhuang Zuhao; in Guangyuan, Household Section Supervising Secretary Wu Yuying; in Zixian, Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Works Cai Ruhui; and in Pixian, Selected Scholar Jiang Tenglong.

sentences.zh: 而安嶽進士王起峨、渠縣禮部員外郎李含乙，皆舉義兵討賊，不克死。

translations.literal: And Wang Qi'e of Anyue, a jinshi, and Li Hanyi of Quxian, an Outer Secretary in the Ministry of Rites, all raised righteous armies to attack the rebels and died when they could not prevail.
translations.idiomatic: And Wang Qi'e of Anyue, a jinshi, and Li Hanyi of Quxian, an Outer Secretary in the Ministry of Rites, all raised righteous armies to attack the rebels and died when they could not prevail.

sentences.zh: 高其勛，字懋功。

translations.literal: Gao Qixun, styled Maogong.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Qixun, styled Maogong.

sentences.zh: 初襲千戶，後舉武鄉試，為黔國公標下中軍。

translations.literal: At first he inherited a post as company commander; later he passed the military provincial examination and served as middle army officer under the Duke of Qian, Mu Biao.
translations.idiomatic: At first he inherited a post as company commander. Later he passed the military provincial examination and served as middle army officer under the Duke of Qian, Mu Biao.

sentences.zh: 吾必奎反，擢參將，守禦武定。

translations.literal: When Wu Bikuí rebelled, he was promoted to vice general and defended Wuding.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu Bikuí rebelled, he was promoted to vice general and defended Wuding.

sentences.zh: 及沙定洲再反，分兵來攻。

translations.literal: When Sha Dingzhou rebelled again, he sent troops to attack.
translations.idiomatic: When Sha Dingzhou rebelled again, he sent troops to attack.

sentences.zh: 固守月余，城陷，衣冠望北拜，服毒死。

translations.literal: After holding out for more than a month, the city fell; in court dress he bowed toward the north, took poison, and died.
translations.idiomatic: After holding out for more than a month, the city fell. In court dress he bowed toward the north, took poison, and died.

sentences.zh: 時有陳正者，世為大理衛指揮，未嗣職。

translations.literal: At that time there was one Chen Zheng, whose family for generations had been commanders of the Dali Guard; he had not yet succeeded to the post.
translations.idiomatic: At that time there was one Chen Zheng, whose family for generations had been commanders of the Dali Guard, though he had not yet succeeded to the post.

sentences.zh: 沙賊陷城，督眾巷戰，手馘數賊而死。

translations.literal: When Sha's rebels took the city, he led the crowd in street fighting and personally severed the heads of several rebels before he died.
translations.idiomatic: When Sha's rebels took the city, he led the crowd in street fighting and personally severed the heads of several rebels before he died.

sentences.zh: 王承憲者，襲祖職為楚雄衛指揮，擢遊擊，為副使楊畏知前鋒。

translations.literal: Wang Chengxian inherited his grandfather's post as commander of the Chuxiong Guard, was promoted to mobile corps commander, and served as vanguard to Vice Commissioner Yang Weizhi.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Chengxian inherited his grandfather's post as commander of the Chuxiong Guard, was promoted to mobile corps commander, and served as vanguard to Vice Commissioner Yang Weizhi.

sentences.zh: 定洲來攻，凡守禦備悉，畏知深倚之。

translations.literal: When Dingzhou came to attack, he made every preparation for defense, and Weizhi relied on him deeply.
translations.idiomatic: When Dingzhou came to attack, he made every preparation for defense, and Weizhi relied on him deeply.

sentences.zh: 賊去復至，承憲偕土官那龠等出城沖擊，賊皆披靡，俄為流矢所中死。

translations.literal: The rebels withdrew and returned; Chengxian went out of the city with the native official Na Yuè and others to charge, and the rebels were all routed, but soon he was struck by a stray arrow and died.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew and returned. Chengxian went out of the city with the native official Na Yuè and others to charge, and the rebels were all routed, but soon he was struck by a stray arrow and died.

sentences.zh: 弟承瑱力戰死，一軍盡歿。

translations.literal: His younger brother Chengzhen fought fiercely and died; the whole army was wiped out.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Chengzhen fought fiercely and died, and the whole army was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 賊進圍大理時，太和縣丞王士傑佐上官畢力捍禦，城陷，死城上。

translations.literal: When the rebels advanced to besiege Dali, Taihe Assistant Magistrate Wang Shijie assisted his superior with all his strength in defense; when the city fell he died on the wall.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels advanced to besiege Dali, Taihe Assistant Magistrate Wang Shijie assisted his superior with all his strength in defense. When the city fell he died on the wall.

sentences.zh: 同死者，大理府教授段見錦、經歷楊明盛及子一甲、司獄魏崇治。

translations.literal: Those who died with him were Dali Prefecture Instructor Duan Jianjin, Prefecture Administrator Yang Mingsheng and his son Yijia, and Prison Warden Wei Chongzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died with him were Dali Prefecture Instructor Duan Jianjin, Prefecture Administrator Yang Mingsheng and his son Yijia, and Prison Warden Wei Chongzhi.

sentences.zh: 而故永昌府同知蕭時顯，解任，以道阻，寓居大理，亦自經。

translations.literal: Former Vice Prefect of Yongchang Prefecture Xiao Shixian, having left office and being blocked on the road, was lodging in Dali and also hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Former Vice Prefect of Yongchang Prefecture Xiao Shixian, having left office and being blocked on the road, was lodging in Dali and also hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 士人同死者，舉人則高拱極投池死，楊士俊同母妻妹自焚死。

translations.literal: Among the literati who died together, of selected scholars Gao Gongji drowned himself in a pool, and Yang Shijun burned himself to death together with his mother, wife, and younger sister.
translations.idiomatic: Among the literati who died together, of selected scholars Gao Gongji drowned himself in a pool, and Yang Shijun burned himself to death together with his mother, wife, and younger sister.

sentences.zh: 諸生則尹夢旗、夢符、馮大成倡義助守，罵賊死，楊憲偕妻女、子婦、侄女、孫女、弟婦一門自焚死。

translations.literal: Of students, Yin Mengqi, Mengfu, and Feng Dacheng raised the call to righteousness and helped in the defense, cursed the rebels, and died; Yang Xian burned himself to death together with his wife, daughter, daughter-in-law, niece, granddaughters, and younger brother's wife—one household in all.
translations.idiomatic: Of students, Yin Mengqi, Mengfu, and Feng Dacheng raised the call to righteousness and helped in the defense, cursed the rebels, and died. Yang Xian burned himself to death together with his wife, daughter, daughter-in-law, niece, granddaughters, and younger brother's wife—one household in all.

sentences.zh: 楊{孫心}既死復蘇，妻竟死。

translations.literal: Yang Sun had died and come back to life, but his wife died in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Sun had died and come back to life, but his wife died in the end.

sentences.zh: 人稱太和節義為獨盛雲。

translations.literal: People said that Taihe's fidelity and righteousness were unrivaled in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: People said that Taihe's fidelity and righteousness were unrivaled in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 單國祚者，會稽人，為通海典史。

translations.literal: Shan Guozuo was a native of Kuaiji and served as archive clerk of Tonghai.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Guozuo was a native of Kuaiji and served as archive clerk of Tonghai.

sentences.zh: 城陷，握印坐堂上，罵賊被殺，印猶在握。

translations.literal: When the city fell he sat in the hall holding the seal, cursed the rebels, and was killed; the seal was still in his hand.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he sat in the hall holding the seal, cursed the rebels, and was killed; the seal was still in his hand.

sentences.zh: 縣人葬之諸葛山下。

translations.literal: The people of the county buried him beneath Zhuge Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: The people of the county buried him beneath Zhuge Mountain.

sentences.zh: 張耀，字融我，三原人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yao, styled Rongwo, was a native of Sanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yao, styled Rongwo, came from Sanyuan.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: In the Wanli period he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wanli period he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 知聞喜縣，慈惠撫民，民為立祠。

translations.literal: As magistrate of Wenxi County he was kind and gentle in governing the people, and the people built a shrine to him.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Wenxi County he was kind and gentle in governing the people, and the people built a shrine to him.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，歷官貴州布政使。

translations.literal: In the Chongzhen period he rose through the offices to Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the Chongzhen period he rose through the offices to Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠死，其部將孫可望、李定國等率眾奔貴州。

translations.literal: When Zhang Xianzhong died, his generals Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and others led their followers into Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Xianzhong died, his generals Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and others led their followers into Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 耀急言於巡撫，請發兵民守禦，巡撫以眾寡不敵難之。

translations.literal: Yao urgently spoke to the grand coordinator, asking that troops and people be mobilized for defense; the grand coordinator demurred, saying the force was too few to match the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: Yao urgently spoke to the grand coordinator, asking that troops and people be mobilized for defense. The grand coordinator demurred, saying their force was too small to match the enemy.

sentences.zh: 俄賊眾奄至，耀率家眾乘城拒擊。

translations.literal: Soon the rebel host arrived suddenly; Yao led his household onto the wall to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the rebel host arrived suddenly. Yao led his household onto the wall to resist.

sentences.zh: 城陷被執，賊帥與耀皆秦人，說之曰：「公若降，當用為相。」

translations.literal: When the city fell he was seized; the rebel commander, like Yao a man of Qin, said to him, "If you submit, you will be made chief minister.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell he was seized. The rebel commander, like Yao a man of Qin, said to him, "If you submit, you will be made chief minister.

sentences.zh: 耀怒詈不屈，賊執其妾媵述之曰：「降則免一家死。」

translations.literal: Yao cursed him in rage and would not yield; the rebels seized his concubines and attendants and said, "Submit and your whole household will be spared."
translations.idiomatic: Yao cursed him in rage and would not yield. The rebels seized his concubines and attendants and said, "Submit and your whole household will be spared."

sentences.zh: 耀詈益甚，賊殺之，並其家屬十三人。

translations.literal: Yao cursed all the more fiercely, and the rebels killed him together with thirteen members of his household.
translations.idiomatic: Yao cursed all the more fiercely, and the rebels killed him together with thirteen members of his household.

sentences.zh: 時鄉官吳子騏、劉琯、楊元瀛等率鄉兵敗賊，賊來益眾，戰敗被執，俱不屈死。

translations.literal: At that time Village Officers Wu Ziqi, Liu Guan, Yang Yuanying, and others led local militia and defeated the rebels; when the rebels came in greater numbers they were defeated, seized, and all refused to submit and died.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Village Officers Wu Ziqi, Liu Guan, Yang Yuanying, and others led local militia and defeated the rebels. When the rebels came in greater numbers they were defeated and seized, and all refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 子騏，字九逵，貴陽人。

translations.literal: Ziqi, styled Jiukui, was a native of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Ziqi, styled Jiukui, came from Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 萬歷中，舉於鄉，知興寧縣。

translations.literal: In the Wanli period he passed the provincial examination and served as magistrate of Xingning County.
translations.idiomatic: In the Wanli period he passed the provincial examination and served as magistrate of Xingning County.

sentences.zh: 天啟時，安邦彥圍貴陽，子騏以母在城內，倉皇棄官歸。

translations.literal: In the Tianqi period, when An Bangyan besieged Guiyang, Ziqi, because his mother was inside the city, hurriedly abandoned his post and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the Tianqi period, when An Bangyan besieged Guiyang, Ziqi, because his mother was inside the city, hurriedly abandoned his post and returned.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十年，蠻賊阿烏謎叛，陷大方城，逐守將。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chongzhen the barbarian rebel A Wumi revolted, took Dafang City, and drove off the defending commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year of the Chongzhen reign the barbarian rebel A Wumi revolted, took Dafang City, and drove off the defending commander.

sentences.zh: 總督朱燮元屬子騏詣六廣，走書召諸目，曉以利害，果乞降。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zhu Xieyuan charged Ziqi to go to Liuguang, sent letters summoning the chieftains, and explained advantage and harm; they indeed begged to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zhu Xieyuan charged Ziqi to go to Liuguang, sent letters summoning the chieftains, and explained advantage and harm, and they indeed begged to surrender.

sentences.zh: 燮元上其功，優旨獎賞。

translations.literal: Xieyuan submitted a report of his merit, and an excellent edict rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: Xieyuan submitted a report of his merit, and an excellent edict rewarded him.

sentences.zh: 琯戶部主事，元瀛府同知，並起家鄉舉。

translations.literal: Guan was a Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, Yuanying was a Vice Prefect, and both had begun their careers as selected scholars.
translations.idiomatic: Guan was a Principal Clerk in the Ministry of Revenue, Yuanying was a Vice Prefect, and both had begun their careers as selected scholars.

sentences.zh: 同時譚先哲，平壩衛人，子騏同年生也。

translations.literal: At the same time there was Tan Xianzhe of Pingba Guard, a classmate of Ziqi.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time there was Tan Xianzhe of Pingba Guard, a classmate of Ziqi.

sentences.zh: 官戶部郎中。

translations.literal: He served as Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He served as Director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 賊陷其城，與裏人石聲和皆闔家殉難。

translations.literal: When the rebels took his city, he and his fellow townsman Shi Shenghe suffered calamity together with their whole households.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels took his city, he and his fellow townsman Shi Shenghe suffered calamity together with their entire households.

sentences.zh: 聲和，天啟中，舉於鄉，官寧前兵備參議。

translations.literal: Shenghe, in the Tianqi period, passed the provincial examination and served as military intendant of Ningqian.
translations.idiomatic: Shenghe, in the Tianqi period, passed the provincial examination and served as military intendant of Ningqian.

sentences.zh: 有顧人龍者，定番州人，嘗出仕，解職家居。

translations.literal: There was one Gu Renlong, a man of Dingfan Prefecture, who had once entered office, resigned his post, and lived at home.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Gu Renlong, from Dingfan Prefecture, who had once served in office, resigned, and lived quietly at home.

sentences.zh: 流賊來犯，率士民拒守，殺賊甚眾。

translations.literal: When roving bandits came to attack, he led gentry and commoners in resisting defense, and killed very many bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When roving bandits attacked, he led the gentry and people in defense and slew a great many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 城破，大罵而死。

translations.literal: When the city fell, he cursed loudly and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the city fell, he cursed them to the end and died.

sentences.zh: 可望寇安平，僉事臨川曾益集眾拒守，城陷死之。

translations.literal: Kewang raided Anping; Vice Commissioner Zeng Yi of Linchuan gathered the masses to resist and defend, and when the city fell, died there.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kewang raided Anping; Zeng Yi, a vice commissioner from Linchuan, rallied the people to hold the city, and died when it fell.

sentences.zh: 曾異撰，榮昌人。

translations.literal: Zeng Yizhuan was a man of Rongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Yizhuan was a native of Rongchang.

sentences.zh: 舉於鄉，知永寧州。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination and served as prefect of Yongning Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination and was appointed prefect of Yongning Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 可望既陷貴州，將長驅入雲南。

translations.literal: After Kewang had already captured Guizhou, he was about to drive straight into Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Once Kewang had taken Guizhou, he prepared to drive straight into Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 異撰與其客江津進士程玉成、貢生龔茂勛謀曰：「州據盤江天險，控扼滇、黔，棄之不守，事不可為矣。」

translations.literal: Yizhuan plotted with his guest Cheng Yucheng, a jinshi of Jiangjin, and Gong Maoxun, a tribute student, saying, "The prefecture holds the natural barrier of the Pan River and commands Yunnan and Guizhou; to abandon it undefended is to make the cause impossible.
translations.idiomatic: Yizhuan consulted his guest Cheng Yucheng, a jinshi of Jiangjin, and the tribute student Gong Maoxun, saying, "This prefecture sits on the Pan River's natural fortress and holds the throat of Yunnan and Guizhou. To abandon it without a fight is to throw away all hope.

sentences.zh: 遂集眾登陴守，城陷，自焚死。

translations.literal: He then gathered the masses, mounted the walls to defend, and when the city fell, burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: He then rallied the people, manned the walls, and when the city fell burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 米壽圖，宛平人。

translations.literal: Mi Shoutu was a man of Wanping.
translations.idiomatic: Mi Shoutu was a native of Wanping.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，由舉人知新鄉縣。

translations.literal: During the Chongzhen reign, having entered service as a provincial graduate, he served as magistrate of Xinxiang County.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he entered service as a provincial graduate and became magistrate of Xinxiang County.

sentences.zh: 土寇來犯，督吏民破走之，斬首千二百余級。

translations.literal: When local bandits came to attack, he directed clerks and commoners to rout them, beheading more than twelve hundred.
translations.idiomatic: When local bandits attacked, he led clerks and townspeople in beating them back and took more than twelve hundred heads.

sentences.zh: 以治行征授南京御史。

translations.literal: For his record in governance he was summoned and appointed censor at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: For his excellence in governance he was summoned and appointed a censor at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十五年四月極論監軍張若騏罪，言：「若騏本不諳軍旅，諂附楊嗣昌，遂由刑曹調職方。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year he denounced at length the crimes of army supervisor Zhang Ruoqi, saying, "Ruoqi was originally ignorant of military affairs; he flattered Yang Sichang and was thus transferred from the Ministry of Justice to the Bureau of Military Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year of Chongzhen he fiercely denounced army supervisor Zhang Ruoqi, saying, "Ruoqi never understood warfare. He flattered Yang Sichang and was moved from the Ministry of Justice to the Bureau of Military Appointments.

sentences.zh: 督臣洪承疇孤軍遠出，若騏任意指揮，視封疆如兒戲。

translations.literal: Commissioner Hong Chengchou led an isolated army far afield, yet Ruoqi directed at will, treating the frontier as child's play.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou marched deep with a lone army, yet Ruoqi directed operations as he pleased and treated the frontier like a game.

sentences.zh: 虛報大捷，躐光祿卿，冒功罔上，恃鄉人謝升為內援。

translations.literal: He falsely reported great victories, leaped to Chamberlain for Attendants, claimed merit to deceive his superiors, and relied on his fellow townsman Xie Sheng as a supporter within the court.
translations.idiomatic: He reported false victories, vaulted to Chamberlain for Attendants, stole credit to deceive the throne, and leaned on his fellow townsman Xie Sheng for support inside the palace.

sentences.zh: 升奸險小人，非與若騏駢斬，何以慰九廟之靈。」

translations.literal: Sheng is a treacherous and base creature; unless he is executed alongside Ruoqi, how can the spirits of the Nine Temples be consoled?
translations.idiomatic: Xie Sheng is a treacherous, base man. Unless he is executed together with Ruoqi, how can the spirits of the Nine Temples be appeased?

sentences.zh: 會廷臣多糾若騏，遂論死，升亦除名。

translations.literal: At that time many court officials impeached Ruoqi, and he was sentenced to death; Sheng was also struck from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Soon many officials at court joined in impeaching Ruoqi. He was sentenced to death, and Xie Sheng was struck from the rolls as well.

sentences.zh: 初，嗣昌倡練兵之議，擾民特甚。

translations.literal: Earlier, Sichang had championed the plan to drill troops, disturbing the people exceedingly.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Yang Sichang had championed the plan to drill new troops, and the people suffered terribly for it.

sentences.zh: 壽圖疏陳十害，又言：「往時督撫多用京卿，今封疆不靖，遇卿貳則爭先，推督撫則引避，宜嚴加甄別，內外兼補。」

translations.literal: Shoutu memorialized listing ten harms, and further said, "In former times governors-general and governors were often drawn from capital officials; now that the frontier is unsettled, when they meet vice-ministerial posts they scramble to be first, but when governors-general and governors are proposed they shrink back; strict selection should be applied, appointing from both within and without the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shoutu submitted a memorial listing ten harms, and added, "In the past governors-general and governors were often chosen from capital officials. Now the frontier is in turmoil: when a vice-ministerial post opens, men scramble forward; when a governorship is proposed, they shrink back. Appointments should be strictly screened, drawing on talent both inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 因劾偏沅巡撫陳睿謨、廣西巡撫林贄貪黷。

translations.literal: He thereupon impeached Chen Ruimo, governor of Bianyuan, and Lin Zhi, governor of Guangxi, for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: He then impeached Chen Ruimo, governor of Bianyuan, and Lin Zhi, governor of Guangxi, for greed and corruption.

sentences.zh: 帝納其言。

translations.literal: The emperor accepted his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor accepted his advice.

sentences.zh: 十七年五月，福王立，馬士英薦用阮大鋮，壽圖論劾。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year the Prince of Fu was enthroned; Ma Shiying recommended Ruan Dacheng for appointment, and Shoutu denounced and impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the seventeenth year the Prince of Fu ascended the throne. Ma Shiying recommended Ruan Dacheng for office, and Shoutu denounced and impeached him.

sentences.zh: 七月，出按四川。

translations.literal: In the seventh month he went out to inspect Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month he was sent to inspect Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 時川地已為張獻忠所據，命吏部簡堪任監司守令者從壽圖西行。

translations.literal: Sichuan was already held by Zhang Xianzhong; the Ministry of Personnel was ordered to select capable intendants, prefects, and magistrates to follow Shoutu west.
translations.idiomatic: Sichuan was already in Zhang Xianzhong's hands. The Ministry of Personnel was ordered to choose capable intendants, prefects, and magistrates to follow Shoutu west.

sentences.zh: 至則與督師王應熊、總督樊一蘅等聯絡諸將，號召遠近，漸復川南郡縣。

translations.literal: On arrival he joined with Grand Secretary Wang Yingxiong, Governor Fan Yiheng, and others to coordinate the generals, calling the near and far, and gradually recovered the prefectures and counties of southern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he worked with Grand Secretary Wang Yingxiong, Governor Fan Yiheng, and others to coordinate the generals, rally the region, and gradually recover the prefectures and counties of southern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 唐王立，擢右僉都御史，巡撫貴州。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Tang was enthroned, he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right and made governor of Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Tang was enthroned, he was promoted to Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right and appointed governor of Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 大清順治四年，獻忠遺黨孫可望等陷貴陽，壽圖出奔沅州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi of the Great Qing, Sun Kewang and other remnants of Xianzhong's faction captured Guiyang; Shoutu fled to Yuanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Shunzhi under the Great Qing, Sun Kewang and other remnants of Zhang Xianzhong's faction took Guiyang, and Shoutu fled to Yuanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月，沅州亦陷，壽圖死之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Yuanzhou also fell, and Shoutu died there.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Yuanzhou also fell, and Shoutu died defending it.

sentences.zh: 耿廷箓，臨安河西人。

translations.literal: Geng Tingluo was a man of Hexi in Lin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Geng Tingluo was a native of Hexi in Lin'an.

sentences.zh: 天啟四年舉於鄉。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianqi he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tianqi he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，知耀州，有能聲。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen he served as magistrate of Yao Prefecture and won repute for competence.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he served as magistrate of Yao Prefecture and earned a reputation for ability.

sentences.zh: 十五年夏，疏陳時政，言：「將多不若將良，兵多不若兵練，餉多不若餉核。」

translations.literal: In the summer of the fifteenth year he memorialized on current policy, saying, "Many generals are not as good as good generals; many troops are not as good as drilled troops; much pay is not as good as audited pay.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the fifteenth year he memorialized on affairs of state, saying, "Many generals are not as good as capable generals; many soldiers are not as good as trained soldiers; much pay is not as good as audited pay.

sentences.zh: 又言：「諸臣恩怨當忘，廉恥當勵。

translations.literal: He further said, "Officials should forget private enmities and rouse their sense of honor.
translations.idiomatic: He went on, "Officials should forget private grudges and steel their honor.

sentences.zh: 小怨必報，何不大用於斷頭飲血之元兇；

translations.literal: Yet for small grievances they must take revenge—why not instead employ them fully against the chief villains who drink blood from severed heads?
translations.idiomatic: Yet they avenge the smallest slight—why not instead throw that energy against the arch-villains who revel in blood?

sentences.zh: 私恩必酬，何不廣用於鵠面鳩形之赤子。」

translations.literal: If they must repay private favors, why not instead extend their efforts widely to the emaciated common people?
translations.idiomatic: If they must repay private favors—why not spend that loyalty on the starving people, faces gaunt and bodies wasted?"

sentences.zh: 優旨褒納。

translations.literal: The throne responded with a gracious edict praising and accepting his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The throne answered with a gracious edict praising and accepting his counsel.

sentences.zh: 擢山西僉事，改監宣府軍。

translations.literal: He was promoted to vice commissioner of Shanxi and transferred to supervise the Xuanfu army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to vice commissioner of Shanxi and reassigned to supervise the army at Xuanfu.

sentences.zh: 十七年，京師陷，走南都。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the capital fell; he fled to the Southern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the capital fell, and he fled to the Southern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月以張獻忠亂四川，命加太仆少卿赴雲南監沙定洲軍，由建昌入川討賊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because Zhang Xianzhong was ravaging Sichuan, he was ordered promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and sent to Yunnan to supervise Sha Dingzhou's army, entering Sichuan through Jianchang to attack the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, with Zhang Xianzhong ravaging Sichuan, he was promoted to Vice Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud and sent to Yunnan to supervise Sha Dingzhou's army, entering Sichuan by way of Jianchang to attack the rebels.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，四川巡撫馬乾罷，即拜廷箓右僉都御史代之。

translations.literal: The following March, when Sichuan Governor Ma Qian was dismissed, Tingluo was immediately appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: The next March, when Sichuan governor Ma Qian was dismissed, Tingluo was immediately appointed Vice Censor-in-Chief of the Right in his place.

sentences.zh: 未赴，而定洲作亂，蜀地亦盡失，遂止不行。

translations.literal: Before he could take up the post, Dingzhou rebelled and Sichuan was entirely lost, so he stopped and did not go.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the post, Sha Dingzhou rebelled and all of Shu was lost, so he never went.

sentences.zh: 後李定國掠臨安，過河西，廷箓聞之赴水死。

translations.literal: Later Li Dingguo plundered Lin'an; passing Hexi, Tingluo heard of it and drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: Later Li Dingguo raided Lin'an. As his forces passed Hexi, Tingluo heard of it and drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 妻楊被執，亦不屈死。

translations.literal: His wife Yang was captured and also died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: His wife, née Yang, was captured and likewise refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 馬乾者，昆明人。

translations.literal: Ma Qian was a man of Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Qian was a native of Kunming.

sentences.zh: 舉崇禎六年鄉試，為四川廣安知州。

translations.literal: He passed the provincial examination in the sixth year of Chongzhen and served as magistrate of Guang'an Prefecture in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the provincial examination in the sixth year of Chongzhen and served as magistrate of Guang'an Prefecture in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 夔州告警，巡撫邵捷春檄乾攝府事。

translations.literal: When Kuizhou sounded the alarm, Governor Shao Jiechun ordered Qian to act in the prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: When Kuizhou raised the alarm, Governor Shao Jiechun ordered Qian to take charge of the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 張獻忠攻圍二十余日，固守不下。

translations.literal: Zhang Xianzhong besieged it for more than twenty days, but Qian held firm and the city did not fall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Xianzhong besieged it for more than twenty days, yet Qian held firm and the city did not fall.

sentences.zh: 督師楊嗣昌兵至，圍始解。

translations.literal: When Grand Secretary Yang Sichang's troops arrived, the siege was finally lifted.
translations.idiomatic: When Grand Secretary Yang Sichang's army arrived, the siege was at last broken.

sentences.zh: 擢川東兵備僉事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to military vice commissioner of eastern Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to military vice commissioner of eastern Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 成都陷，巡撫龍文光死，蜀人共推乾攝巡撫事。

translations.literal: When Chengdu fell and Governor Long Wenguang died, the people of Shu together urged Qian to act as governor.
translations.idiomatic: When Chengdu fell and Governor Long Wenguang died, the people of Shu together pressed Qian to act as governor.

sentences.zh: 賊陷重慶，留其將劉廷舉戍守。

translations.literal: The bandits captured Chongqing and left their general Liu Tingju to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels took Chongqing and left their general Liu Tingju to hold it.

sentences.zh: 乾擊走之，復其城。

translations.literal: Qian attacked and drove him off, recovering the city.
translations.idiomatic: Qian attacked, drove him off, and recovered the city.

sentences.zh: 督師王應熊劾乾淫掠，奪職提訊。

translations.literal: Grand Secretary Wang Yingxiong impeached Qian for licentious plunder; his post was stripped and he was summoned for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretary Wang Yingxiong impeached Qian for rapine and plunder. His post was stripped and he was ordered brought in for trial.

sentences.zh: 會蜀地大亂，詔命不至，乾行事如故。

translations.literal: But Sichuan was in great turmoil and imperial orders could not reach him; Qian conducted affairs as before.
translations.idiomatic: But Sichuan was in chaos and imperial orders never reached him, so Qian continued to govern as before.

sentences.zh: 乃傳檄遠近，協力討賊。

translations.literal: He then issued proclamations far and near, urging united effort to attack the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He then sent proclamations far and wide, calling on all to join in attacking the rebels.

sentences.zh: 廷舉既敗去，賊遣劉文秀等以數萬眾來攻，乾固守。

translations.literal: After Tingju was defeated and withdrew, the bandits sent Liu Wenxiu and others with tens of thousands to attack; Qian held firm.
translations.idiomatic: After Liu Tingju was beaten and withdrew, the rebels sent Liu Wenxiu and others with tens of thousands to attack, and Qian held fast.

sentences.zh: 曾英等援兵至，賊敗還。

translations.literal: When Zeng Ying and other relief troops arrived, the bandits were defeated and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Zeng Ying and other relief forces arrived, the rebels were defeated and driven back.

sentences.zh: 及獻忠死，其黨孫可望等南奔，大清兵追至重慶，乾戰敗而死。

translations.literal: When Xianzhong died, his followers Sun Kewang and others fled south; Qing troops pursued to Chongqing, and Qian was defeated and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Xianzhong died, his followers Sun Kewang and others fled south. Qing troops pursued as far as Chongqing, and Qian was defeated and killed in battle.

sentences.zh: 席上珍，姚安人。

translations.literal: Xi Shangzhen was a man of Yao'an.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Shangzhen was a native of Yao'an.

sentences.zh: 崇禎中，舉於鄉。

translations.literal: During Chongzhen he passed the provincial examination.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chongzhen reign he passed the provincial examination.

sentences.zh: 磊落尚節義，聞孫可望、李定國等入雲南，與姚州知州何思、大姚舉人金世鼎據姚安城拒守。

translations.literal: Open and upright, he honored integrity; hearing that Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and others had entered Yunnan, he joined Yao Prefecture Magistrate He Si and Jin Shiding, a provincial graduate of Dayao, in holding Yao'an city to resist.
translations.idiomatic: Upright and high-minded, he prized honor and duty. When he heard that Sun Kewang, Li Dingguo, and others had entered Yunnan, he joined Yao Prefecture Magistrate He Si and Jin Shiding, a provincial graduate of Dayao, in holding Yao'an and resisting them.

sentences.zh: 可望遣張虎攻陷之，世鼎自殺，上珍、思被執至昆明。

translations.literal: Kewang sent Zhang Hu to attack and capture it; Shiding killed himself; Shangzhen and Si were seized and taken to Kunming.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang sent Zhang Hu to attack and take the city. Shiding killed himself; Shangzhen and He Si were captured and taken to Kunming.

sentences.zh: 可望呵之，上珍厲聲曰：「我大明忠臣，肯為若屈耶！」

translations.literal: Kewang berated him; Shangzhen said in a stern voice, "I am a loyal subject of Great Ming—would I bow to the likes of you!
translations.idiomatic: Kewang reviled him. Shangzhen answered in a fierce voice, "I am a loyal subject of Great Ming—do you think I would bow to the likes of you?

sentences.zh: 可望怒，命引出斬之，大罵不絕，遂磔於市。

translations.literal: Kewang raged and ordered him led out and beheaded; he cursed without cease and was dismembered in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang flew into a rage and ordered him led out and beheaded. Shangzhen cursed without pause and was dismembered in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 思亦不屈死。

translations.literal: Si also died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: He Si likewise refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 有孔師程者，昆明人，以從事得官。

translations.literal: There was one Kong Shicheng, a man of Kunming, who had obtained office through a staff appointment.
translations.idiomatic: There was a man named Kong Shicheng, from Kunming, who had entered office through a staff post.

sentences.zh: 至是糾合晉寧、呈貢諸州縣，起兵拒賊。

translations.literal: At this time he rallied the prefectures and counties of Jinning and Chenggong and raised troops to resist the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: At this time he rallied the prefectures and counties of Jinning and Chenggong and raised troops to resist the rebels.

sentences.zh: 定國率眾奄至，師程遁，晉寧知州石阡冷陽春、呈貢知縣嘉興夏祖訓並死之。

translations.literal: Dingguo led his forces suddenly upon them; Shicheng fled; Leng Chongchun, magistrate of Jinning from Shiqian, and Xia Zuxun, magistrate of Chenggong from Jiaxing, both died there.
translations.idiomatic: Li Dingguo swept down on them with his army. Shicheng fled; Leng Chongchun, magistrate of Jinning from Shiqian, and Xia Zuxun, magistrate of Chenggong from Jiaxing, both died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 晉寧舉人段伯美，諸生余繼善、耿希哲助陽春城守，亦殉難。

translations.literal: Duan Bomei, a provincial graduate of Jinning, and licentiates Yu Jishan and Geng Xizhe helped Chongchun defend the city and also died for the cause.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Bomei, a provincial graduate of Jinning, and the licentiates Yu Jishan and Geng Xizhe helped Chongchun hold the city and also died in its defense.

sentences.zh: 賊陷富民，貢生李開芳妻及二子俱赴井死。

translations.literal: When the bandits captured Fumin, the wife and two sons of tribute student Li Kaifang all threw themselves into a well and died.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels took Fumin, the wife and two sons of tribute student Li Kaifang all threw themselves into a well and died.

sentences.zh: 開芳走至松花壩自經，其友王朝賀掩埋訖，亦自經。

translations.literal: Kaifang fled to Songhuaba and hanged himself; his friend Wang Chahe buried him and then also hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: Kaifang fled to Songhuaba and hanged himself. His friend Wang Chahe buried him and then hanged himself as well.

sentences.zh: 在籍知縣陳昌裔不受偽職，為賊杖死。

translations.literal: Chen Changyi, a magistrate at home on leave, refused a bogus appointment and was beaten to death by the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Chen Changyi, a magistrate at home on leave, refused a false appointment and was beaten to death by the rebels.

sentences.zh: 楚雄舉人杜天禎，初佐楊畏知拒沙賊，頻有功。

translations.literal: Du Tianzhen, a provincial graduate of Chuxiong, at first assisted Yang Weizhi in resisting the Sha bandits, winning frequent merit.
translations.idiomatic: Du Tianzhen, a provincial graduate of Chuxiong, had earlier assisted Yang Weizhi in resisting Sha Dingzhou's rebels and won repeated distinction.

sentences.zh: 後畏知督兵擊可望敗績，天禎聞之即自盡。

translations.literal: Later Weizhi led troops against Kewang and was defeated; Tianzhen heard of it and immediately killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: Later Yang Weizhi led troops against Kewang and was defeated. When Tianzhen heard the news, he killed himself at once.

sentences.zh: 臨安之陷，進士廖履亨赴水死。

translations.literal: When Lin'an fell, Jinshi Liao Lüheng drowned himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin'an fell, the jinshi Liao Lüheng drowned himself.

sentences.zh: 徐道興，睢州人。

translations.literal: Xu Daoxing was a man of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Daoxing was a native of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 崇禎末，官雲南都司經歷，署師宗州事，廉潔愛民。

translations.literal: At the end of Chongzhen he served as secretary of the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, acting in the affairs of Shizong Prefecture, incorruptible and loving the people.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the Chongzhen reign he served as secretary of the Yunnan Regional Military Commission, acting prefect of Shizong, honest in office and devoted to the people.

sentences.zh: 孫可望等入雲南，破曲靖。

translations.literal: Sun Kewang and others entered Yunnan and captured Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kewang and his followers entered Yunnan and took Qujing.

sentences.zh: 巡按羅國瓛方按部其地，與知府焦潤生被執。

translations.literal: Investigating Censor Luo Guohuan was on inspection tour there and was captured along with Prefect Jiao Runsheng.
translations.idiomatic: Investigating Censor Luo Guohuan happened to be on inspection there and was captured along with Prefect Jiao Runsheng.

sentences.zh: 可望欲降之，國瓛不屈，攜至昆明，自焚死。

translations.literal: Kewang wished to make them submit; Guohuan would not yield, was taken to Kunming, and burned himself to death.
translations.idiomatic: Kewang tried to force them to submit. Guohuan refused, was taken to Kunming, and burned himself to death.

sentences.zh: 潤生亦不屈死。

translations.literal: Runsheng also died without yielding.
translations.idiomatic: Runsheng likewise refused to submit and died.

sentences.zh: 道興見賊逼，集士民諭之曰：「力薄兵寡，不能抗賊，吾死分也。

translations.literal: Daoxing saw the bandits pressing close; he gathered gentry and commoners and addressed them, saying, "Our strength is slight and our troops few—we cannot resist the bandits; my death is my duty.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing the rebels close in, Daoxing gathered the gentry and people and told them, "Our strength is slight and our troops are few—we cannot hold them off. For me to die is only fitting.

sentences.zh: 若等可速去。」

translations.literal: You may leave quickly.
translations.idiomatic: You should go at once.

sentences.zh: 民請偕行，道興厲聲曰：「封疆之臣死封疆，吾將安之！」

translations.literal: The people asked to leave together; Daoxing said sternly, "An official charged with guarding the frontier dies on the frontier—where would I go!
translations.idiomatic: The people begged to leave with him. Daoxing said fiercely, "An official charged with guarding the frontier dies on the frontier—where would I go?"

sentences.zh: 眾雨泣辭去。

translations.literal: The crowd wept like rain and took their leave.
translations.idiomatic: The crowd wept like rain and took their leave.

sentences.zh: 舍中止一仆，出俸金二錠授之曰：「一以賜汝，一買棺斂我。」

translations.literal: In his dwelling only one servant remained; he took out two ingots of his salary silver and gave them to him, saying, "One is for you; one is to buy a coffin and lay me out.
translations.idiomatic: Only one servant remained in the house. Daoxing took out two ingots of his salary and handed them to him, saying, "One is yours; one is to buy a coffin and lay me out.

sentences.zh: 仆大哭，請從死。

translations.literal: The servant wept loudly and asked to die with him.
translations.idiomatic: The servant wept and begged to die with him.

sentences.zh: 道興曰：「爾死，誰收吾骨？」

translations.literal: Daoxing said, "If you die, who will gather my bones?
translations.idiomatic: Daoxing said, "If you die, who will gather my bones?

sentences.zh: 仆叩頭號泣乃去。

translations.literal: The servant kowtowed and wailed, then departed.
translations.idiomatic: The servant kowtowed, wailing, and at last departed.

sentences.zh: 及賊入署，令出迎其將。

translations.literal: When the bandits entered the yamen, they ordered him to go out and welcome their general.
translations.idiomatic: When the rebels entered the yamen, they ordered him to go out and welcome their general.

sentences.zh: 道興大罵，擲酒杯擊之，罵不絕口，遂被殺。

translations.literal: Daoxing cursed loudly, threw a wine cup at them, and cursed without pause; he was then killed.
translations.idiomatic: Daoxing cursed them, hurled a wine cup in their faces, and never stopped reviling them until they killed him.

sentences.zh: 國瓛，嘉定州人，崇禎十六年進士。

translations.literal: Guohuan was a man of Jiading Prefecture and a jinshi of the sixteenth year of Chongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: Guohuan was a native of Jiading Prefecture and a jinshi of the sixteenth year of Chongzhen.

sentences.zh: 潤生，修撰竑子。

translations.literal: Runsheng was the son of Academician Jiao Hong.
translations.idiomatic: Runsheng was the son of Hanlin Academician Jiao Hong.

sentences.zh: 同時張朝綱，廣通人，由貢生授渾源州同知，解職歸。

translations.literal: At the same time Zhang Chaogang of Guangtong, having entered office as a tribute student and appointed vice magistrate of Hunyuan Prefecture, resigned and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time Zhang Chaogang of Guangtong, who had entered office as a tribute student and served as vice magistrate of Hunyuan Prefecture, resigned and returned home.

sentences.zh: 可望等兵至，與其妻馮並縊死，子諸生耀葬親訖，亦縊死。

translations.literal: When Kewang's troops arrived, he and his wife Feng hanged themselves together; their son Yao, a licentiate, after burying his parents also hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: When Kewang's troops arrived, he and his wife, née Feng, hanged themselves together. Their son Yao, a licentiate, buried them and then hanged himself as well.

sentences.zh: 劉廷標，字霞起，上杭人。

translations.literal: Liu Tingbiao, styled Xiaci, was a man of Shanghang.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Tingbiao, styled Xiaci, was a native of Shanghang.

sentences.zh: 王運開，字子朗，夾江人。

translations.literal: Wang Yunkai, styled Zilang, was a man of Jiajiang.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yunkai, styled Zilang, was a native of Jiajiang.

sentences.zh: 廷標由貢生歷永昌府通判。

translations.literal: Tingbiao, from a tribute student background, served as vice prefect of Yongchang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tingbiao, who had entered service as a tribute student, served as vice prefect of Yongchang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 運開舉於鄉，授永昌推官。

translations.literal: Yunkai passed the provincial examination and was appointed judicial intendant of Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: Yunkai passed the provincial examination and was appointed judicial intendant of Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 沙定洲之亂，黔國公沐天波走永昌。

translations.literal: In Sha Dingzhou's rebellion, the Prince of Qian, Mu Tianbo, fled to Yongchang.
translations.idiomatic: During Sha Dingzhou's rebellion, Prince of Qian Mu Tianbo fled to Yongchang.

sentences.zh: 及孫可望等入雲南，馳檄諭天波降。

translations.literal: When Sun Kewang and the others entered Yunnan, they sent a fast dispatch urging Tianbo to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When Sun Kewang and his followers entered Yunnan, they sent a fast dispatch urging Mu Tianbo to surrender.

sentences.zh: 時運開攝監司事，廷標攝府事，方發兵守瀾滄，而天波將遣子納款，諭兩人以印往。

translations.literal: At the time Yunkai was acting surveillance commissioner and Tingbiao acting prefect; they had just dispatched troops to guard the Lancang crossing, when Tianbo was about to send his son to submit and ordered the two of them to bring their seals.
translations.idiomatic: Yunkai was then serving as acting surveillance commissioner and Tingbiao as acting prefect; they had just sent troops to hold the Lancang crossing when Tianbo prepared to send his son to submit and ordered the two men to deliver their official seals.

sentences.zh: 兩人堅不予，各遣家人走騰越。

translations.literal: The two steadfastly refused to hand them over and each sent their families to flee to Tengyue.
translations.idiomatic: The two men firmly refused and each sent his family to flee to Tengyue.

sentences.zh: 永昌士民聞賊所至屠戮，號泣請運開納款紓禍，運開不可，慰遣之。

translations.literal: The gentry and common people of Yongchang, hearing that the rebels slaughtered wherever they went, wept and begged Yunkai to submit and avert disaster; Yunkai would not agree and comforted and dismissed them.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry and people of Yongchang, hearing that the rebels massacred every place they reached, wept and pleaded with Yunkai to submit and avert disaster; he refused, comforted them, and sent them away.

sentences.zh: 又詣廷標，廷標亦不可，眾大哭。

translations.literal: They went again to Tingbiao; Tingbiao also would not agree, and the crowd wept loudly.
translations.idiomatic: They then went to Tingbiao, who also refused, and the crowd broke into loud weeping.

sentences.zh: 廷標取毒酒將飲，乃散去。

translations.literal: Tingbiao took poisoned wine and was about to drink it, and only then did they disperse.
translations.idiomatic: Tingbiao took up poisoned wine and was about to drink; only then did the crowd disperse.

sentences.zh: 兩人相謂曰：「眾情如此，吾輩惟一死自靖耳。」

translations.literal: The two said to each other, "Sentiment among the people is such as this; we can only settle the matter by dying.
translations.idiomatic: The two said to one another, "The people feel as they do; we have no choice but to die and bring this affair to rest.

sentences.zh: 是夕，運開先自經。

translations.literal: That evening, Yunkai hanged himself first.
translations.idiomatic: That night Yunkai hanged himself first.

sentences.zh: 廷標聞之曰：「我老當先死，王乃先我。」

translations.literal: Tingbiao heard of it and said, "I am old and ought to die first, yet Wang has gone before me.
translations.idiomatic: When Tingbiao heard, he said, "I am old and should have died first, yet Wang has gone ahead of me.

sentences.zh: 遂沐浴，賦詩三章，亦自經。

translations.literal: He then bathed, composed three poems, and hanged himself as well.
translations.idiomatic: He bathed, composed three poems, and hanged himself as well.

sentences.zh: 兩家子弟自騰越來奔喪，厝畢復返。

translations.literal: The younger men of both families came from Tengyue to attend the funerals; when the burials were finished they returned.
translations.idiomatic: The sons of both families came from Tengyue to mourn; after the burials were complete they returned.

sentences.zh: 可望等重兩人死節，求其後，或以運開弟運閎對，即聘之。

translations.literal: Sun Kewang and the others honored the two men's martyrdom, sought their descendants, and when someone named Yunkai's younger brother Yunkui, they immediately offered him an appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Kewang and his followers, honoring the two men's martyrdom, sought out their descendants; when someone named Yunkui, Yunkai's younger brother, they immediately offered him an appointment.

sentences.zh: 行至潞江，謂其仆曰：「吾兄弟可異趣耶！

translations.literal: When he reached the Lujiang, he said to his servant, "Can we brothers take different paths?
translations.idiomatic: On the road to the Lujiang he said to his servant, "Can we brothers choose different ends?

sentences.zh: 吾死，若收吾骨與兄合葬。」

translations.literal: When I die, gather my bones and bury them together with my brother.
translations.idiomatic: When I am dead, gather my bones and bury them with my brother's.

sentences.zh: 遂躍入江死。

translations.literal: He then leaped into the river and died.
translations.idiomatic: Then he leaped into the river and died.
